question: Deshidratados Tropicales avocado oil company owner
markdown:
Deshidratados Tropicales S.A.C. was acquired in 2016 by the French parent company
Laboratoires Expanscience
. It is managed day-to-day by
Sébastien Debrock
, who serves as the Managing Director of the Peru-based plant raw material and avocado oil processing company.
